policies.shred: Exact physical Shred from own deck uses native automatic cast and completed actual record; no replacement draw from a deck cast. Original surviving source receives reward after all cast reactions. Existing full Shred face and no-spellpower policy remain unchanged. Selection amongst physical Shreds uses native sampled choice; cast/reward checkpoints remain M6.
policies.growth: Native repeatable own turn_ended hand-progress, initial raw script values Last Stand2/Bulb1; no invented cap. Value is frozen once at actual spell body. Last Stand samples distinct enemy minions and one ordinary DamageBatch; Bulb performs three native per-cast complete-pool casts. Clock, inherited progress and interruption remain M6.
policies.aura: Three independent owner-end ticks and native Paladin aura area/capacity. Reinforcement recruits physical deck minions by printed Cost<=2, without Battlecry. Gnomish uses native HealBatch; Mekkatorque samples one original active friendly minion then guarded buff/shield. Both Fabled aura leaves retain real Tradeable; TIME_009 root and Fabled assembly stay unsupported. Timers, cost basis and notification order remain M6.
policies.phoenix: Native all-card current-turn play-count cost; acquisition after previous plays queries complete physical history. Each actual Deathrattle installs an independent source-free persistent next either-player end trigger; ConsumePlayerEffect pays each original instance once before ordinary fresh Phoenix hand creation. New installation during an already captured end waits for next natural end; exact checkpoint remains M6.
